goals.title: Answer a question from our documents
goals.summary: An answer taken only from the company's own documents, with where it came from.
goals.text: Answer this question using only the company's own documents: [your question]. Say which documents the answer came from, and tell me plainly if the documents do not cover it.

goals.title: Write a one-page document
goals.summary: A tidy one-page document written from the notes you paste in.
goals.text: Write a one-page document called [document title] for [who will read it] from these notes: [paste your notes here]. Keep it plain and short, and mark anything you had to guess.

goals.title: A plan for a piece of work
goals.summary: A plan for you to read and approve before any work starts.
goals.text: Make a plan for [the piece of work] that should be finished by [date]. Set out the steps, what will be produced and what you need from me. Do not start the work until I have approved the plan.

goals.title: Summary of the week
goals.summary: Everything that was finished this week, in a short list.
goals.text: Summarise everything that was finished this week in a short list, one line each, and say who did it. Then list what is still open and what is waiting for me.

goals.title: Check one document against another
goals.summary: A list of where two documents agree and where they do not.
goals.text: Check [first document] against [second document]. List every place where they disagree or where one leaves out something the other says, and suggest which one should change.
